links.outcome: Readability (SMOG) of ChatGPT-simplified surgical patient education materials versus originals
links.effect: Mean SMOG decreased from 12.1 to 10.5 (P < 10^-9); Flesch-Kincaid -1.6; Coleman-Liau -0.8; sixth-grade level still hard to reach.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o simplification significantly decreased mean Simple Measure of Gobbledygook score from 12.1 to 10.5 (P < 10<sup>-9</sup>), with similar reductions in Coleman-Liau index (-0.8, P < 10<sup>-5</sup>) and Flesch-Kincaid (-1.6, P < 10<sup>-8</sup>).

links.outcome: Whether AI-simplified materials reached sixth-grade reading level appropriate for patients
links.effect: SMOG fell from 12.1 to 10.5, still above the sixth-grade target; word count fell 55% and risks and benefits were often omitted.
links.quote: Achieving the recommended sixth grade reading level may be challenging due to the inherent complexity of medical information.
